title: AMOC and the Gulf Stream

summary: The AMOC is the Atlantic overturning circulation and is not the same thing as the Gulf Stream.
entities: AMOC; Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation; Gulf Stream
---

The AMOC is the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation, a basin-scale loop of warm surface water moving north and colder deep water returning south. It is not the same thing as the Gulf Stream, which is a narrower surface current along the western Atlantic. Researchers discuss a slowdown when fresher water makes high-latitude sinking harder, but the two names should not be swapped for each other.
